metadata.title: When you barely move and Valorant decides to hand you 2 kills WTF?!
metadata.description:
Wait, I just stood here and somehow got 2 kills?
Enemy must’ve been on a coffee break.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the game’s feeling generous.
Valorant logic is pure chaos today.

Tap in if your kills come from pure accident magic!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
